statement: For every L>0, the canonical monotone transport T_L from standard Gaussian measure to d nu_L(t)=Z_L^{-1} exp(L|t|) d gamma_1(t) satisfies Lip(T_L)=T_L'(0)=Z_L=2 exp(L^2/2) Phi(L). Its continuous derivative is strictly smaller than Z_L at every x other than 0, so its full maximizer set is {0}. As L tends to infinity, log Lip(T_L)=L^2/2+log 2-[phi(L)/L](1-L^{-2}+3L^{-4}+O(L^{-6})).
contribution: A complete elementary resolution of the frozen claim: an exact Gaussian-tail quantile identity reduces the global derivative bound to two sign cases, upgrades the cited lower bound to equality, and classifies the unique maximizer. No priority claim is made beyond the documented limited literature search.
